idea-plugin.name: IDEA ChatGPT Dictate
idea-plugin.description: Russian dictation into Codex with OpenAI speech recognition and project-aware technical term correction. Press the hotkey to start or stop recording. Text is inserted at the active composer without sending it. All configuration lives in one settings dialog, including the optional Codex session context.

action.description: Start or stop a recording and insert OpenAI-recognized Russian text into the focused chat prompt
API-ключ, F1–F12, модель исправления текста и история Codex
